en.name: SanDisk Extreme Portable SSD 1TB
en.shortDescription: Rugged 1TB portable SSD with 1050 MB/s transfer speed.
en.description:
## SanDisk Extreme Portable SSD 1TB

A rugged, IP55-rated portable SSD with up to 1050 MB/s read speeds, fast enough for 4K video editing on the go.

- 1 TB capacity
- USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 interface
- IP55 dust and water resistance, drop-proof to 2m
